name: Between Worlds
source:
Between Worlds is a magical and adventurous-filled fantasy themed visual novel where you will assume the role of a male protagonist surrounded by an abundance of gorgeous and fascinating women each with their own unique personality and backstory. It is is based on a theme where the society has a polyamorous culture.
